title: ArtifactReadRequest
description: A ranged read of an engine-owned media artifact through IndeRunApi.readArtifact (ADR 017). Reads are repeatable until the artifact is disposed; each returns at most the engine's configured maximum read size, which bounds what one call -- and one bridge message -- carries.

artifactId.description: MediaArtifact.id of the artifact to read.

offset.description: Byte offset to read from. Absent means 0. An offset equal to the artifact's size returns an empty, final chunk; a larger one is rejected.

maxBytes.description: Most bytes to return. Absent, or larger than the engine's maximum read size, means that maximum.
